description: This file defines an abstract base class for statistical calculations related to maximum and minimum value operations within the PhpSpreadsheet library. It includes a protected static method for adjusting data types, especially to handle strings and booleans appropriately.

classes.name: MaxMinBase
classes.description: Abstract class serving as a base for maximum and minimum calculation classes in the statistical calculation namespace.

methods.name: datatypeAdjustmentAllowStrings
methods.description: Adjusts the data type of a value, converting booleans to integers and strings to zero, for consistent statistical processing.
